Class CreateBillsFromPayments

public without sharing class CreateBillsFromPayments
implements Schedulable

Creates Bill__c records from unassigned Payment2__c records by scheduling and executing a Flow for each account with payments in a given date range. Runs as a Schedulable job that processes the previous week's payments, using chained Queueable jobs to handle each account sequentially.

Methods

public void execute(SchedulableContext context)

Executes the scheduled job. Calculates the previous week's date range (Monday to Sunday) and delegates to runFlow().

Parameters:
    context – The schedulable context provided by the platform.

private static Set<Id> getPaymentsAccounts(
  Date dateFrom,
  Date dateTo
)

Retrieves account IDs that have unassigned payments within the specified period, then resolves them to their parent bill accounts. Filters to only include parent accounts with automatic payments disabled.

Parameters:
    dateFrom – The start date of the billing period.
    dateTo – The end date of the billing period.

Returns:
    Set: The set of resolved bill account IDs.
